title: Browser Privacy Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Free template to request your browsing data from websites and services. Protect your browser privacy with this customizable letter format.
description: A comprehensive letter template to help you request information about your browsing data collection, request deletion of tracking data, or opt-out of browser-based tracking from websites and online services.

sections.content:

sections.heading: Subject Line
sections.content:
Subject: Privacy Request - Browser Data and Tracking Information

Dear Privacy Officer/Data Protection Team,

sections.heading: Introduction and Identification
sections.content:
I am writing to exercise my privacy rights regarding the collection, use, and storage of my browsing data and tracking information. I am a user of your website/service [WEBSITE_URL] and can be identified by the following information:

- Email address: [YOUR_EMAIL]
- Username/Account ID: [USERNAME] (if applicable)
- Approximate dates of usage: [DATE_RANGE]

I am requesting this information under applicable privacy laws including CCPA, GDPR, and other relevant data protection regulations.

sections.heading: Specific Privacy Requests
sections.content:
I am making the following specific requests regarding my browser privacy and data:

1. **Data Access Request**: Please provide details about:
   - What browsing data you collect about me
   - Tracking cookies and pixels placed on my device
   - Browser fingerprinting techniques used
   - Third-party data sharing related to my browsing
   - Cross-site tracking activities

2. **Data Deletion Request**: Please delete:
   - All tracking cookies associated with my visits
   - Browser fingerprint data
   - Browsing behavior profiles
   - Any shared data with third-party trackers

3. **Opt-Out Request**: Please ensure I am opted out of:
   - Behavioral advertising based on browsing data
   - Cross-site tracking
   - Data sales to third parties
   - Browser fingerprinting for tracking purposes

sections.heading: Technical Details
sections.content:
For your reference, I primarily use the following browsers and privacy tools:
- Browser: [BROWSER_NAME]
- Privacy extensions: [PRIVACY_EXTENSIONS]
- I use Incognito Browser and private browsing modes regularly
- I have disabled third-party cookies where possible

Please ensure your response addresses how these privacy measures interact with your tracking systems.

sections.heading: Response Timeline and Format
sections.content:
Please respond to this request within 30 days as required by applicable privacy laws. I would prefer to receive the information in the following format:

- Electronic format (PDF or secure download link)
- Human-readable explanation of technical data collection
- Clear instructions for ongoing opt-out preferences
- Confirmation of any data deletions performed

If you need additional information to process this request, please contact me at [YOUR_EMAIL].

sections.heading: Closing
sections.content:
I appreciate your attention to this privacy request and look forward to your prompt response. Please confirm receipt of this letter and provide a timeline for fulfilling these requests.

Thank you for respecting my privacy rights and helping me maintain better control over my browsing data.

Sincerely,

[YOUR_SIGNATURE]
[YOUR_PRINTED_NAME]
